description: The Thal Industries Corporation Limited was incorporated on 7 September 1953 and was privatised in 1998. It produces several grades of sugar at two units — Layyah Sugar Mills in Layyah, with a crushing capacity of 13,000 tons of cane a day, and Safina Sugar Mills at Lalian, District Chiniot, with 8,000 tons a day — and co-generates power, exporting surplus electricity to the national grid. A condensing system installed in 2006 and successive expansions took the company from an original 1,200 tons a day to its present capacity.
